name: lookup_order
description: Look up one order: its status, items and delivery date. Do not use it for questions about how the shop works; use search_help.

name: search_help
description: Search the help centre for articles about how the shop works. Do not use it for a specific order; use lookup_order.

name: create_ticket
description: Open a ticket for a person on the support team to handle. Do not use it for a question a help article answers; use search_help first.
